_step: 6b — EEAT audit (CORE-EEAT 80-item via aaron-seo-geo:content-quality-auditor, run by an INDEPENDENT subagent — not self-graded)
_scale: 0-100 per dimension; ratings: 90-100 Excellent / 75-89 Good / 60-74 Medium / 40-59 Low.
veto: None — C01 (clickbait) PASS (title 'Content Marketing Services for Canadian Businesses' matches body exactly); T04 (affiliate disclosure) N/A (no affiliate links); R10 (data consistency) PASS (3 external stats live-verified — 4.5x leads at 16+ posts/mo via Semrush, 84% B2B paid distribution via Content Marketing Institute, blog posts top-5 highest-ROI 2025/22.26% via HubSpot; no internal contradictions). cap_applied: false.

C_contextual_clarity.note: Intent nailed (title=body); content marketing defined on first use; direct answer + outcome in opening; broad query coverage (services, agency, B2B, video, strategy, distribution, pricing); explicit 'Who our content marketing services are for' audience section; clean semantic flow that closes on the consultation CTA. Gaps: no explicit out-of-scope statement (C05 Partial); own-vs-augment decision cue present but no A-vs-B framework (C08 Partial); FAQ is bold-paragraph not schema-marked in the draft (C09 Partial — FAQPage schema auto-emitted at Step 7).

O_organization.note: Weakest dimension. Clean H2 hierarchy, well-balanced lists, tight single-topic chunking, bold key concepts/CTAs, consistent terminology with no filler. Held back by: no summary/TL;DR box (O02 Fail), no comparison data table (O03 Fail — highest GEO lever; AI extracts tables), no TOC/anchor nav (O08 Fail), no multimedia (O10 Fail), schema present only via template at Step 7 (O05 Partial).

R_referenceability.note: 3 named Tier-1/2 sources (Semrush, HubSpot, Content Marketing Institute) with precise figures, each mapped immediately to its claim and live-verified accurate; citation density ≥1 per 500 words; full entity precision; descriptive internal-link cluster (SEO, social-media-marketing, link-building, digital-marketing-services). Gaps: <5 total data points (R01 Partial), no methodology/last-updated in draft (R05/R06 Fail — R06 template-auto), HTML semantics via template (R09 Partial).

E_exclusivity.note: Capped by design — standard service-page category content with no first-party data, no named framework, no primary research, no proprietary visuals, no downloadable tool, no forward predictions. Partial credit for differentiation only: anti-filler/anti-AI-mill contrarian stance (E04), Canadian/GTA + integrated-with-IT gap-filling (E06), content+SEO+IT synthesis (E09), comparable depth (E08). Expected for a transactional service page.

Exp_experience.note: CAPPED BY DESIGN — the deliberate no-fabrication posture (no citable client results/testimonials/portfolio yet → deferred eeat-authority-circle-back; never invent proof). Credit only for documented 4-step process (Exp03 Pass) and honestly acknowledged limitations — 'we do not invent guarantees or promise specific rankings' (Exp10 Pass), plus first-person 'we' + action verbs (Exp01 Partial). No own metrics, before/after, tangible proof, or usage duration — all expected absences under the operator rule.

Ept_expertise.note: Named author byline (Hassan Sadiq, Founder & CEO) + Microsoft Solutions Partner credential; accurate professional vocabulary (topic clusters, editorial calendar, publishing cadence, pillar guide, B2B sales cycles); transparent reasoning ('strategy comes first… every piece has a purpose before a word is written'); cross-domain content+SEO+social+IT integration. Gaps: no on-page bio >30 words/avatar (Ept01 Partial), service-page-level technical depth not deep how-to (Ept04 Partial), no field-history (Ept07 Fail), fact-check/review claimed but no visible 'Reviewed by' stamp (Ept10 Partial).

A_authority.note: 6/10 items are site-level/off-page (backlinks, media, awards, publishing record, brand search volume, Knowledge Graph, community) — N/A on a standalone page, excluded from the weighted total and weights re-normalized. On-page scored items: entity consistency PASS (NexFortis/Hassan Sadiq/MS Partner consistent), partnership signal PASS (certified Microsoft Solutions Partner — strongest authority anchor), media mentions FAIL, on-page social proof FAIL (none — by design).

T_trust.note: Honest posture (no invented guarantees, no fixed-date ranking promises, realistic timelines), transparent CTA + month-to-month/no-lock-in/no-hidden-fees, certification disclosed, no ads, non-YMYL, no affiliate exposure. Gaps: no on-page reviews/social proof (T09 Fail — by design), no correction/update policy (T06 Fail), editorial stance stated but no formal published policy (T05 Partial), legal/contact/SLA surfaced via global layout+footer not the draft (T01/T02/T10 Partial — template handles at Step 7).

remaining_soft_spots: All post-publish hardening — none blocking, none requiring fabricated proof. Highest-leverage GEO win: add a true non-priced 'what's included' comparison/spec element or summary box (lifts O02/O03 + GEO extraction). Add a lightweight visible 'Reviewed by Hassan Sadiq' editorial stamp + author bio (Ept01/Ept10/T05). Add one out-of-scope sentence (C05) and an own-vs-augment decision cue framing (C08). Add a real lead-magnet asset e.g. a content-audit checklist (E07). Several are Step-7 template-auto: FAQPage + Service + Person schema (O05/C09/R09), last-updated/<time> (R06), and contact/legal/NAP via global layout+footer (T01/T02). Experience + Exclusivity remain capped by the deliberate no-client-proof posture — do NOT fabricate; revisit under eeat-authority-circle-back when real wins/results/testimonials exist.
_done_check: PASS — overall 62/100 SHIP; no veto (C01/T04/R10 all clear); Referenceability 70 from 3 live-verified Tier-1 cited stats; Experience (25) + Exclusivity (20) capped by the deliberate no-portfolio/no-proof operator rule (deferred eeat-authority-circle-back, never fabricate); Authority flagged Insufficient Data (6/10 site-level) and excluded with weights re-normalized. Weighted total uses Landing-Page weights (C20/O10/R5/E5/Exp5/Ept5/A25/T25), A re-normalized out → 62. Audited via the standardized 80-item rubric by an independent subagent, not a self-grade.
